words.definition: vt. 超过，超车；（坏事）突然降临

examples.en: China overtook Japan to become the world's second-largest economy.
examples.zh: 中国超过日本，成为世界第二大经济体。

examples.en: Do not overtake on a sharp bend or in heavy fog.
examples.zh: 急转弯或大雾时切勿超车。

words.usage: 过去式 overtook，过去分词 overtaken。本义超车；引申指超越、（坏事）突然降临。与 surpass 近义，overtake 兼指超车。
collocations: overtake a car 超车
be overtaken by a crisis 被危机突袭
overtake Japan 超越日本
words.mnemonic: over（越过）+take（拿）→ 拿到前面 → 超过

words.definition: n. 外部，外表；adj. 外部的

examples.en: The plain exterior of the building conceals a magnificent hall.
examples.zh: 建筑朴素的外观之内藏着富丽堂皇的大厅。

examples.en: He kept a calm exterior despite the pressure.
examples.zh: 尽管压力重重，他外表依然平静。

words.usage: n. the exterior of the building 建筑外观；adj. exterior walls 外墙。反义词 interior。写作句式 beneath a calm exterior。
collocations: the exterior of the building 建筑外观
a calm exterior 平静的外表
exterior walls 外墙
words.mnemonic: exter（外）+ior → 外部；对比 interior

examples.en: The Earth rotates on its axis once every twenty-four hours.
examples.zh: 地球每二十四小时自转一周。

examples.en: Nurses rotate shifts so that the ward is always covered.
examples.zh: 护士们轮班，病房因此始终有人值守。

words.usage: rotate on its axis 绕轴自转；rotate crops 轮作；rotate shifts 轮班。派生：rotation n. 旋转、轮换。英美重音位置不同。
collocations: rotate on its axis 绕轴自转
rotate crops 轮作庄稼
rotate shifts 轮换班次
words.mnemonic: rot（转，如 rotate 词根）+ate → 转圈 → 旋转

examples.en: Invert the formula and you will get the correct answer.
examples.zh: 把这个公式倒过来，你就能得到正确答案。

examples.en: She inverted the vase to pour out the stale water.
examples.zh: 她把花瓶倒过来，倒掉里面的臭水。

words.usage: vt. 使倒置：invert a glass；inverted commas 引号。派生：inverse adj. 相反的；in inverse proportion to 成反比为考研高频。
collocations: invert a glass 倒置杯子
inverted commas 引号
in inverse proportion 成反比
words.mnemonic: in（入）+vert（转）→ 转向反面 → 倒转

words.definition: vt. 油煎，油炸；vi. 被油炸

examples.en: Mother fried some eggs and bacon for breakfast.
examples.zh: 母亲煎了鸡蛋和培根当早餐。

examples.en: The fish is first fried, then simmered in sauce.
examples.zh: 鱼先煎后用酱汁焖。

words.usage: fry sth in oil 用油煎炸；frying pan 煎锅；French fries 薯条。复合词 small fry 无名小卒。形容词 fried 油炸的。
collocations: frying pan 煎锅
French fries 炸薯条
fry an egg 煎鸡蛋
words.mnemonic: fried rice 炒饭 → 用油炒炸 → 油炸

words.definition: vt./vi. 打猎；搜寻，追捕；n. 搜寻

examples.en: The volunteers hunted for the missing hiker all night.
examples.zh: 志愿者彻夜搜寻失踪的登山者。

examples.en: The police hunted the suspect across three states.
examples.zh: 警方跨越三个州追捕嫌疑人。

words.usage: hunt for sth 寻找；hunt down 追捕到；job hunting 找工作。派生：hunter n. 猎人。witch hunt 政治迫害为阅读高频引申义。
collocations: hunt for a job 找工作
hunt down criminals 追捕罪犯
a nationwide hunt 全国大搜捕
words.mnemonic: 谐音「憨特」→ 憨憨地打猎 → 打猎；搜寻

words.definition: n. 套房；一套（家具、软件）

examples.en: The bride and groom stayed in the honeymoon suite.
examples.zh: 新婚夫妇住进了蜜月套房。

examples.en: The lab purchased a complete suite of analytical software.
examples.zh: 实验室购置了整套分析软件。

words.usage: 发音同 sweet，勿与 suit（套装；适合）混淆。a suite of rooms／software 一套房间／软件。honeymoon suite 蜜月套房。

synonyms.note: 公寓住宅；suite 指酒店套房

collocations: honeymoon suite 蜜月套房
a suite of software 一套软件
a suite of furniture 一套家具
words.mnemonic: 音同 sweet → 甜蜜的套房

examples.en: The leaders will discuss climate change at next week's summit.
examples.zh: 领导人将在下周的峰会上讨论气候变化。

examples.en: They finally reached the summit after eight hours of climbing.
examples.zh: 经过八小时攀登，他们终于登顶。

words.usage: 本义山顶，引申指政府首脑峰会（a summit meeting／talks）与顶点 the summit of one's career 事业巅峰。派生：summitry n. 峰会外交。国际政治阅读高频。
collocations: a summit meeting 峰会
reach the summit 登顶
the summit of one's career 事业巅峰
words.mnemonic: sum（总）+mit（端）→ 最高的一端 → 峰顶；峰会

words.definition: adj. 椭圆形的；n. 椭圆形

examples.en: The ring features a large oval diamond.
examples.zh: 这枚戒指镶有一颗硕大的椭圆形钻石。

examples.en: An oval face suits almost any hairstyle.
examples.zh: 鹅蛋脸几乎适合任何发型。

words.usage: adj. an oval face 鹅蛋脸；the Oval Office 白宫椭圆形办公室为专名。n. 椭圆形。几何术语为 ellipse。
collocations: an oval face 鹅蛋脸
the Oval Office 椭圆形办公室
an oval mirror 椭圆形镜子
words.mnemonic: ov（卵，ovum 卵子）+al → 卵形的 → 椭圆

examples.en: Water evaporates faster in dry, hot conditions.
examples.zh: 干燥炎热条件下水蒸发得更快。

examples.en: Investors' confidence evaporated as losses mounted.
examples.zh: 随着亏损扩大，投资者的信心烟消云散。

words.usage: 本义蒸发；引申义「（支持、信心等）消失殆尽」为高频：support evaporates。派生：evaporation n. 蒸发。可替换 disappear。
collocations: water evaporates 水蒸发
support evaporates 支持烟消云散
heat evaporates water 热使水蒸发
words.mnemonic: e（出）+vapor（蒸气）→ 化蒸气跑掉 → 蒸发

words.definition: n. 污点；vt. 玷污，染色

examples.en: The ink stain on the contract was impossible to remove.
examples.zh: 合同上的墨渍无法清除。

examples.en: The bribery case stained the company's image for years.
examples.zh: 这起行贿案多年来玷污着公司的形象。

words.usage: n. an ink stain 墨水渍；remove a stain 除渍。vt. 引申「玷污名誉」。派生：stainless adj. 无污点的（stainless steel 不锈钢）。
collocations: remove a stain 去除污渍
stain one's reputation 玷污名声
stainless steel 不锈钢
words.mnemonic: 谐音「死钉」→ 污渍死死钉在布上 → 污点

words.definition: n. 主食；订书钉；adj. 主要的

examples.en: Rice remains the staple food for over half of the world's population.
examples.zh: 大米仍是世界上一半以上人口的主食。

examples.en: Crime dramas are a staple of prime-time television.
examples.zh: 犯罪剧是黄金档电视的固定节目类型。

words.usage: n. staple food 主食；adj. a staple product 主要产品。派生：stapler n. 订书机。考研侧重「主食；主要的」二义。
collocations: staple food 主食
a staple of the diet 饮食基本构成
staple products 主要产品
words.mnemonic: sta（stay 保持）+ple → 天天都有的 → 主食

examples.en: How the funds are allocated is left to the committee's discretion.
examples.zh: 资金如何分配由委员会自行决定。

examples.en: A good journalist knows when to act with discretion.
examples.zh: 优秀记者懂得何时审慎行事。

words.usage: at the discretion of sb 由某人酌定；use discretion 谨慎行事。派生：discretionary adj. 酌情的；同根形容词 discreet 谨慎的。
collocations: at one's discretion 由某人酌定
use discretion 谨慎行事
discretionary spending 可自由支配开支
words.mnemonic: discreet（谨慎）的名词 → 谨慎；酌处权

examples.en: The witness evaded every question about his past.
examples.zh: 证人回避了所有关于他过去的问题。

examples.en: The tycoon was jailed for evading millions in taxes.
examples.zh: 这位大亨因逃税数百万而入狱。

words.usage: evade taxes 逃税；evade the question 回避问题。派生：evasion n. 逃避（tax evasion）；evasive adj. 含糊其辞的。
collocations: evade taxes 逃税
evade the question 回避问题
evade capture 逃避抓捕
words.mnemonic: e（出）+vade（走）→ 走为上 → 逃避

examples.en: Users can retrieve their passwords via the registered email.
examples.zh: 用户可通过注册邮箱找回密码。

examples.en: The hunters sent the dog to retrieve the fallen bird.
examples.zh: 猎人放狗去衔回被击落的鸟。

words.usage: retrieve sth from… 取回；retrieve data 检索（计算机高频）。派生：retrieval n. 检索，information retrieval 信息检索。
collocations: retrieve information 检索信息
retrieve data from… 从…取回数据
retrieve a lost item 取回失物
words.mnemonic: re（回）+trieve（找）→ 找回来 → 取回；检索

words.definition: vt. 包含，容纳；遏制，抑制

examples.en: The new drug contains no artificial ingredients.
examples.zh: 这种新药不含人工成分。

examples.en: Firefighters fought through the night to contain the blaze.
examples.zh: 消防员彻夜奋战以控制火势。

words.usage: 表「包含」时不用于进行时；contain the spread of the virus 遏制蔓延为考研高频。派生：container n. 集装箱；containment n. 遏制。
collocations: contain the virus 遏制病毒
contain oneself 克制自己
contain the spread of rumors 遏制谣言传播
words.mnemonic: con（一起）+tain（握）→ 握在里面 → 包含；遏制

examples.en: Chemical waste from the mine contaminated the groundwater.
examples.zh: 矿场的化学废料污染了地下水。

examples.en: The samples were contaminated during transportation.
examples.zh: 样品在运输过程中受到了污染。

words.usage: be contaminated by／with 被…污染；contaminated water 受污染的水。派生：contamination n. 污染；contaminant n. 污染物。
collocations: contaminated water 受污染的水
contaminate the environment 污染环境
contaminate the food supply 污染食品供应
words.mnemonic: con+tamin（接触）→ 一碰就脏 → 污染

examples.en: Eating more fiber keeps the bowels healthy.
examples.zh: 多摄入膳食纤维有助于肠道健康。

examples.en: Deep in the bowels of the ship, the engine roared.
examples.zh: 在船的深处，发动机轰鸣着。

words.usage: 常用复数 bowels 指肠道；比喻用法 the bowels of the earth 地球深处。医学搭配 bowel cancer 肠癌、irritable bowel syndrome。
collocations: bowel cancer 肠癌
the bowels of the earth 地球深处
irritable bowel syndrome 肠易激综合征
words.mnemonic: bowl（碗）里弯弯绕 → 像碗的管道 → 肠

examples.en: She sells handmade jewelry at a weekend market stall.
examples.zh: 她在周末集市的小摊上卖手工首饰。

examples.en: The peace talks stalled over the border dispute.
examples.zh: 和谈因边界争端陷入停顿。

words.usage: n. a market stall 集市摊位。v. 发动机熄火：the engine stalled；谈判停顿：talks stalled。stall for time 拖延时间。
collocations: a market stall 集市摊位
stall for time 拖延时间
the engine stalled 发动机熄火
words.mnemonic: 谐音「死透」→ 车死火 → 熄火；停滞

examples.en: They took out a twenty-year loan to buy the apartment.
examples.zh: 他们贷了二十年的款买下这套公寓。

examples.en: The museum has loaned several paintings to the exhibition.
examples.zh: 博物馆已出借数幅画作给这场展览。

words.usage: take out a loan 取得贷款；repay a loan 还贷；on loan 借出中的（借调）。美式动词常用 loan，英式多用 lend。
collocations: take out a loan 取得贷款
repay a loan 偿还贷款
on loan to… 借调至…
words.mnemonic: l+oan（似 own 拥有）→ 借来暂拥有 → 贷款
